LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 10.3.1 DETERMINERS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners, part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we indicate that something belongs to somebody?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 10.3.1 Determiners together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
 Self-efficacy is developed as the learner pays attention to detail and corrects errors in sentences.

 Communication and collaboration are enhanced as the learner practices using articles and possessives to communicate

clearly and effectively.

Values:
Respect is achieved as the learner acknowledges diverse opinions as they work with peers to engage in language games using

articles.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs)

Child rights is enhanced as the learner composes a song on the rights of children using articles and possessives.

Link to other subjects:

The learner relates the concepts of articles and possessive’s in learning other languages such as Kiswahili.
